evidence.title: Generic foliar spray-window safety parameters
evidence.source: Standard foliar application practice: avoid inversion conditions in still air, avoid drift in strong wind, avoid application into rain before the product is rainfast.
limitations: generic good practice for foliar application, not a product label and not product specific
delta-T, wind and rainfast bounds are conservative defaults and are not tuned to any nozzle, adjuvant or formulation
equipment capacity assumes one knapsack sprayer and one operator
an approved label always overrides these values

product:quantis.purpose: abiotic stress management, particularly heat and drought
product:quantis.lead_rationale: applied ahead of a persistent stress onset rather than after it
product:quantis.wind_limit_note: limits are at the 10 m measurement height forecasts report, equivalent to roughly 3-15 km/h at 2 m
product:quantis.lead_after_rationale: still worth applying this many days into a stress episode: the product is for the stress the crop is in as well as the stress it is about to meet

product:isabion.purpose: amino acid and peptide plant support: vigour through developmental phases and recovery from adverse conditions
product:isabion.lead_rationale: supports recovery as well as anticipation, so a same-day window is allowed
product:isabion.wind_limit_note: limits are at the 10 m measurement height forecasts report, equivalent to roughly 3-15 km/h at 2 m
product:isabion.lead_after_rationale: recovery support remains useful well after the episode, which is what this product is positioned for

product:coucal.purpose: soil and root zone intervention: nutrient use efficiency, soil condition and root development
product:coucal.not_a_spray_note: COUCAL is applied to the soil, so it has no foliar spray window and carries no crop_ids in this bundle. The spray-window engine is for foliar products; recommending COUCAL needs a soil application pathway that does not exist yet, and listing it against a crop here would make the engine offer a window that makes no sense for it.
